bio.text: Ritchie Torres represents the Bronx in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2020.
According to his official website, he grew up in a public-housing project in the Bronx, raised by his mother.
He was elected to the New York City Council in 2013 at age 25, becoming the city's youngest elected official and the first openly LGBTQ+ person elected to office in the Bronx.
